label: Bible Study
prompt: A bruised _____ shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
verse: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
note: Matthew applies this to Jesus — gentle enough not to snap a cracked reed or snuff a smoking wick.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is _____ of God, and knoweth God.
verse: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
note: Love runs in the family: everyone who loves is born of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four _____ out of the stern, and wished for the day.
verse: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
note: On Paul's shipwreck voyage the sailors dropped four anchors from the stern and 'wished for the day.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now unto the King eternal, _____, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verse: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
note: Recalling his own past as a persecutor, Paul can't help himself — he breaks into praise mid-letter.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the _____ of sin for a season;
verse: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
note: Moses chose suffering with God's people over 'the pleasures of sin for a season' — enjoyable, but temporary.
